# Composing Actors

Actors compose by publishing to each other's topics. No orchestrator, no service registry, no shared code.

```{mermaid}
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  [*]       --> Validator : request
  Validator --> Pricer    : valid_order
  Pricer    --> Risk      : priced_order
  Risk      --> Executor  : approved_order
  Executor  --> [*]       : execution record
```

To insert a compliance check between risk and execution: add one actor, subscribe to `approved_order`, emit `cleared_order`. Existing actors are untouched.

::: {.callout}
**Every actor is identical at the runtime level.** `SQL Tool`, `LLM Agent`, `Compliance Check` — all are the same binary, distinguished only by `ACTOR_TOPIC`, `ACTOR_RESULT_TOPIC`, and `ACTOR_HANDLER`. Adding a step to a pipeline is adding a process to a system.
:::
